description: Insert a tracked DOCX section break after a stable direct-body paragraph. The new boundary preserves the containing section’s page setup and header/footer relationship references. The following section inherits current properties by default; set inherit_properties=false to reset non-relationship properties, and optionally provide page-number/page-size/margin overrides in new_section. Call get_sections again after success because section indexes change.

break_type.description: OOXML start behavior for the following section.

file_path.description: Path to the DOCX or ODT file.

inherit_properties.description: Whether the following section retains current non-relationship properties. Default: true. Header/footer references are always preserved.

new_section.description: Optional page-number and page-setup overrides for the following section. Complete page size/margins are required when reset removes those elements.

paragraph_id.description: Stable paragraph id returned by read_file; must identify a direct main-body paragraph that does not already end a section.

name: insert_section_break
